title: The Prairie That Needs Fire
short_teaser: Many prairie ecosystems evolved with periodic fire.
story: Many prairie ecosystems evolved with periodic fire. Carefully managed burns can remove accumulated plant matter, return nutrients to the soil, and help native species compete. Not every form of disruption is destruction; some systems need renewal that looks dramatic from the outside. Nature and place can teach us about timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of seeing a familiar landscape with fresh attention. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
